description: Replace a stack's management token and manage_link. The old token and link stop working immediately. Use this if the manage_link may have leaked. Returns the new token and manage_link once; give the new manage_link to the user privately. Counts toward the stack's daily change limit. Needs the stack id and its current management token. The stack itself is not deleted.

token.description: Management token (wdn_...) returned once by create_alert_stack

title: Reset a stack's manage link
